title: Positional task conditioning for scalable defect detection across product families in large product catalogs
abstract: arXiv:2609.09567v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Product families in large product catalogs suffer from inconsistencies such as duplicates and unit mismatches that degrade customer experience. Detecting these requires reasoning over multiple error types across lengthy product listings, where LLM classification quality degrades due to long-context limitations. We address this by decomposing detection into focused sub-tasks that reduce context and isolate error types, improving F1 from 52% to 87%. For scalable deployment, we introduce Positional Task Conditioning (PTC), which distills this capability into a single smaller model by reinforcing task identity at structural prompt boundaries. PTC outperforms rationale-based distillation across five models and two architecture families, achieving within 1.79% F1 of the frontier at upto 98% lower cost. Our system is deployed across multiple countries processing 10+ million product families.

translated_title: 面向大型产品目录中跨产品族可扩展缺陷检测的位置任务条件化方法
translated_abstract: 大型产品目录中的产品族存在重复项和单位不匹配等不一致问题，这些问题会降低客户体验。检测这些问题需要对冗长的产品列表中的多种错误类型进行推理，而由于长上下文的限制，大语言模型的分类质量会下降。我们通过将检测分解为聚焦的子任务来解决这一问题，这些子任务减少了上下文并隔离了错误类型，将F1分数从52%提高到87%。为了实现可扩展的部署，我们提出了位置任务条件化（PTC），该方法通过在结构化提示边界处强化任务身份，将这种能力蒸馏到单个更小的模型中。PTC在五个模型和两种架构家族上均优于基于推理的蒸馏方法，在成本降低高达98%的情况下，F1分数与前沿模型相差不超过1.79%。我们的系统已在多个国家部署，处理超过1000万个产品族。
tldr: 提出位置任务条件化（PTC）方法，通过将缺陷检测分解为聚焦子任务并蒸馏到更小的模型中，在成本降低高达98%的情况下实现接近前沿大模型的性能（F1达87%），并已在多国部署处理超千万产品族。
